text:
morgan: Heads up — new contributor hit a blocker running the Ruby sample app on macOS. `bundle install` fails during ext build with `ld: library not found for -lstdc++`. They dropped out of onboarding.
alia: annoying. Do we know which runner/version? macOS versions changed stdlib behavior recently.
sam: what does extconf.rb look like? sometimes people call `have_library('stdc++')` which is not portable.
morgan: extconf.rb is very naive (copied from a gist): `have_library('stdc++')` + `$CXXFLAGS << ' -O2'`. No platform checks. Works fine on linux CI.
jess: Contributor said they were using rbenv ruby 3.1.4 on macOS 13. Appveyor? no GH macos-latest.
alia: Two immediate DX fixes: 1) add a pure-Ruby fallback layer so `bundle exec rake` works without compiling the ext, 2) make ext build opt-in via an environment var (e.g., `ENABLE_NATIVE_EXT=1`) and document it in CONTRIBUTING.md.
sam: Also update extconf.rb to detect Darwin and avoid calling `have_library('stdc++')` — instead add flags like `if /darwin/ =~ RUBY_PLATFORM; $LDFLAGS << ' -stdlib=libc++' end` and guard compile attempts.
morgan: Agreed. I'll draft a small PR that: a) adds lib/sampleapp/fast_json_fallback.rb used when native ext not present, b) updates extconf.rb with darwin guard and clearer error message, c) updates README/CONTRIBUTING with macOS build notes and the opt-in var.
jess: can we also add a low-frequency GitHub Actions job to our CI matrix: macos-latest `bundle install && bundle exec rake build`? That way native-ext PRs get a quick smoke check. Not every push, maybe `workflow_dispatch` or weekly, but at least on PRs touching ext/.
morgan: I'll add a macos smoke job gated by `paths: ['ext/**']` so it only runs when native bits change.
sam: nice. please include a small unit test that loads the fallback module so we don't regress (simple round-trip JSON transform).
alia: Also add a note recommending Xcode CLT and Homebrew for common deps. Example snippet for CONTRIBUTING: `If you see ld errors on macOS: install Xcode Command Line Tools (xcode-select --install), and try: export LDFLAGS='-stdlib=libc++' && bundle install`.
jess: devex-bot: create issue 'macOS native ext build blocks Ruby sampleapp onboarding' from this thread.
devex-bot: Issue #823 created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/issues/823
morgan: thanks — I'll land a small PR with fallback + extconf fixes + CI tweak. Ping for reviews.
sam: i'll review, focus on minimal surface area and doc clarity.
jess: great DX improvement — should cut one of the common first-day friction points. :rocket:
